description.value: Quality Inn & Suites Downtown Vancouver is a mid-range Choice Hotels property on Granville Street, centrally positioned between Gastown, Yaletown, and Stanley Park. The hotel houses The Morrissey, a full-service pub and restaurant with a rock-and-roll theme, directly on the premises. Its downtown location puts guests within easy reach of Vancouver's seawall and mixed-use cycling paths.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The hotel website confirms this is a real, operating mid-range chain hotel at 1221 Granville Street; the address matches OSM exactly. The website prominently lists phone numbers 604.901.4933 and 1.800.903.0796, which differ from OSM's +1-778-907-2918, so the website value is used and the discrepancy flagged. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, or cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the fetched pages; Wi-Fi is corroborated by OSM tags (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no) and a truncated 'FRE...' entry on the amenities page; the onsite Morrissey Pub confirms both early breakfast and on-premises evening food.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-778-907-2918, but the hotel website prominently shows 604.901.4933 (main) and 1.800.903.0796 (toll-free). Website value used.
Email mismatch: OSM has info@qualityvancouver.com; website contact header displays a different address (appears to be info@qualityinndowntownvancouver.com based on domain context).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operational chain hotel in downtown Vancouver with an active website and confirmed amenities; straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists seeking overnight accommodation.

Early or packed breakfast.detail: Hot breakfast served daily at The Morrissey Pub and Restaurant; hotel guests receive a discount on the full breakfast menu including bacon, eggs, potatoes, and toast

Nearby evening food.detail: The Morrissey Pub and Restaurant is located within the hotel, offering meals, drinks, and a large whiskey and scotch selection
